(2) On Arbitrum, find the distributor contract address (Arbiscan / Anyone gov repo), then in DuneSQL query erc20_arbitrum.evt_Transfer WHERE from = <distributor> (claims/payouts to relay operators) grouped by date_trunc('month'|'day'), OR the bridged ANYONE token's evt_Transfer if rewards are denominated in bridged ANYONE; if the distributor exposes a decoded Claim/Reward event, use searchTablesByContractAddress on that distributor address and aggregate the reward-amount field per period. (3) For burns (revenue), aggregate transfers to 0x0/0xdead of the Ethereum ANYONE contract once a burn mechanism is confirmed (current 12-month result is empty, so confirm whether burns occur at all). (4) Cross-check totals against the official dashboard's bandwidth/relay widgets and CoinGecko/protocol-published emission schedule. Non-Dune alternative: pull from the Anyone Protocol API / The Graph subgraph if published, or read the distributor contract's reward-epoch events directly via Arbiscan/Blockscout (chain 42161, get_token_transfers_by_address on the distributor) and bucket by month.

dashboards.name: Algorand (by _hectorand)
dashboards.notes: Top NAME-substring hit for 'algorand'. Verified via getDashboard: dashboard is EMPTY (0 visualization widgets, 0 text widgets). No emission/reward/burn series. Community user, not the Algorand Foundation. Included only because it is the closest name match; not usable for the build.

dashboards.name: Goracle - DeFi adoption on Algorand
dashboards.notes: Verified via getDashboard: contains ONLY a single marketing text widget (a 2022 BSC News press release about the Goracle oracle rebrand). Zero queries, zero charts, no ALGO emission/reward data. Not usable.

dashboards.name: FolksFinance xALGO Overview (by sigrlami)
dashboards.notes: Name-match on 'xALGO' (Folks Finance liquid-staking derivative). Pertains to a DeFi liquid-staking wrapper, not native ALGO protocol emissions/participation/governance rewards. Folks Finance is a multi-chain protocol with EVM (Wormhole-bridged FOLKS) activity Dune can index, but this does NOT give the native-L1 ALGO emission/reward/burn series the build needs. Community-owned.

dashboards.name: Algo (by hugomrc)
dashboards.notes: Name-substring hit for 'algo'. getDashboard returned a malformed-position parse error so contents could not be fully enumerated, but it is an old (id 11938) community dashboard and there is no native Algorand chain data on Dune for it to draw emission/reward series from. Treated as not usable for the build.

dashboards.name: [Algorand] - List CEX Addresses (query, by CoinLedger team)
dashboards.notes: Verified query SQL: SELECT address,cex_name FROM cex_algorand.addresses. This is the ONLY genuinely Algorand-scoped table on Dune (a static CEX-address label table). It yields no time series and no emission/reward/burn amounts. Confirms Dune's Algorand coverage is limited to address labels, not native chain/block-reward data.

fallback: Dune has NO native Algorand L1 chain data (no algorand.blocks / algorand.transactions / payout or reward tables; only a static cex_algorand.addresses label table and AI-mislabeled queries that actually hit ethereum.transactions). No pre-built Dune dashboard yields a per-period ALGO emission/participation-reward/governance-reward/burn series. Build the series off-chain from Algorand's own data sources instead: (1) ALGO total/circulating supply over time and the protocol-fixed distribution schedule from the Algorand Foundation's published Community/Ecosystem allocation and vesting docs (algorand.foundation 'Algo Dynamics' / transparency reports) for the canonical emission/unlock schedule; (2) per-period on-chain reward flows via the Algorand Indexer REST API (indexer.algorand.network or a hosted Nodely/AlgoNode indexer): GET /v2/accounts/{addr}/transactions to pull pay-type and the protocol 'rewards' field (block/participation rewards were paid from the rewards pool address until the post-2022 incentive change; the consensus incentive payouts after Algorand 2.0/Dynamic Lockup are pay transactions from the FeeSink/RewardsPool addresses). Aggregate by month/day on the rewards-pool and incentive-payout source addresses to get emitted-ALGO-per-period; (3) Governance rewards specifically: the Algorand Foundation Governance program paid rewards quarterly from a known Foundation governance-rewards wallet, queryable via the same Indexer (per-period = per-governance-period payout sums) and cross-checkable against governance.algorand.foundation period-results pages. (4) For a quick aggregate cross-check of circulating-supply deltas as a proxy for net emission, use CoinGecko/CoinMetrics ALGO supply history APIs. Net: build via Algorand Indexer API + Foundation schedule docs, not Dune."

dashboards.name: POL Staking stats (Polygon Labs)
dashboards.notes: Official Polygon Labs query (team 3890), latest execution COMPLETED. Single richest official source for the build input. Contains a daily 'rewards' CTE: SUM(reward)/1e18 from matic_ethereum.RootChainProxy_evt_NewHeaderBlock (checkpoint/validator-incentive emission) with day-level amount AND cumulative; also computes total_matic_supply (mints minus burn-to-0xdead) and total staked. Period enum (All Time / 365d / 90d / 30d). reward_amount column = the per-day emitted-token series; resample to monthly. Validator-incentive half of the build input out of the box.

dashboards.name: Polygon validator rewards & checkpoints (Polygon Labs)
dashboards.notes: Cleanest standalone official per-period emission series. SQL: sum(reward/1e18) as total_reward from matic_ethereum.RootChainProxy_evt_NewHeaderBlock grouped by proposer and date_trunc({{Aggregated_by}}) with an Aggregated_by enum = Day/Week/Month/Year. Set Aggregated_by=Month and sum total_reward across proposers to get monthly validator-incentive (checkpoint-reward) emission in POL. Latest execution COMPLETED. Direct minimal build input for validator incentives.

dashboards.name: Polygon (Messari)
dashboards.notes: Well-known analyst (Messari), quarterly-report-grade. Has a Validators section (validator rewards via query 1150190) AND a Treasury section driven by query 1474026 'Polygon Treasury Flows (Revised)' with parameters 1-Start Date / 2-End Date / 3-Granularity (Day/Week/Month). The treasury query tracks net MATIC flows in/out of Polygon Foundation, Vesting, Treasury2, and the delegation address. Best ready-made surface for the 'community treasury per year' half of the build input (per-period net treasury emission/flow). 'other' in covers = the treasury/community-treasury dimension.

dashboards.name: Matic Inflation (21Shares by FalconX)
dashboards.notes: Well-known analyst team (21Shares research / 21co). Tracks daily MATIC ERC20 mint/transfer balances on Ethereum plus a burn stream (from 0x70bca... to 0xdead) with daily 'burned' and cumulative. Yields a per-day net-inflation / burn token series. CAVEAT: latest execution state = FAILED (likely a stale/broken CTE), so the query needs a re-run/repair before use; the underlying logic is sound and re-usable. Use as a cross-check on the supply/burn side, not the validator-emission side.

dashboards.name: Polygon Emission Rate (DeNet Community)
dashboards.notes: Community. Computes Polygon PoS block-reward MATIC emission per hour from polygon.blocks: (2 * 1.05 * count(blocks)) minus burned base fee (basefee*gas_used/1e18). This is the L2 block-production emission stream (a different emission channel from L1 checkpoint/validator rewards). Resample hourly to monthly. CAVEAT: uses hardcoded constants (2 POL base reward, 1.05 performance multiplier, fixed start block 23850000); verify constants against current Polygon tokenomics (post-1%-annual-emission redesign) before relying on absolute values.

fallback: If you skip dashboards and build the per-period series directly, the canonical on-chain source for POL/MATIC validator-incentive emission is the L1 checkpoint-reward event: matic_ethereum.RootChainProxy_evt_NewHeaderBlock on Dune (every checkpoint submission emits a 'reward' field in wei). Build: SELECT date_trunc('month', evt_block_time) AS month, SUM(reward)/1e18 AS pol_emitted FROM matic_ethereum.RootChainProxy_evt_NewHeaderBlock GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1. That is exactly what the two official Polygon Labs queries (5966871, 4414708) do; clone either and set granularity to Month. For the COMMUNITY TREASURY half, there is no single mint event; reconstruct net per-period treasury flow from MATIC erc20 transfers in/out of the known treasury/foundation/vesting/delegation addresses (Foundation 0xb316fa9Fa91700D7084D377bfdC81Eb9F232f5Ff, Vesting 0xcbfE11b78C2E6cB25C6eDA2C6Ff46CD4755c8fCA, Treasury2 0xcD6507d87F605F5E95C12F7c4B1fC3279dc944aB, Delegation 0x40730f34668afcb3884f050cbc3d376a444bbe44) per Messari query 1474026, or pull the post-2024 1%-annual-emission schedule (validator incentives + community treasury split) from the Polygon contract / docs. For total supply and burn cross-check, use erc20_ethereum.evt_Transfer for the MATIC token 0x7d1afa7b718fb893db30a3abc0cfc608aacfebb0 (mints from 0x0; burns to 0xdead) and the new POL token 0x455e53cbb86018ac2b8092fdcd39d8444affc3f6. Off-Dune alternative: token-terminal / Polygon staking API, or read emission params directly from the EmissionManager / default-staking contract via an RPC eth_call. Note the MATIC->POL migration (Sept 2024): combine MATIC-era and POL-era token addresses for a continuous series."

dashboards.name: HiveMapper (PYOR)
dashboards.notes: Best packaged dashboard. PYOR is a known DePIN data analyst team; maintained fork of @murathan's work, built by @maybeYonas. Explicit BME (Burn-Mint-Emissions) methodology: mints = contributor rewards emissions, burns = map-consumption revenue. Has Weekly Overview, KPIs, and Revenue (burn) sections, 17 viz widgets, tagged hivemapper/solana/depin. Underlying queries group by week from spl_token_solana mint/burn on the HONEY mint, so they yield a per-period emitted/burned token series. Not the protocol's own handle but the strongest analyst-grade build surface.

dashboards.name: Hivemapper Monthly Token Burns
dashboards.notes: Cleanest standalone monthly-burn build input. date_trunc('month') over spl_token_solana.spl_token_call_burn filtered to the HONEY mint, returns burns_honey (token amount) and burns_usd per month from 2023-09. Recently executed (Dec 2025). Owner also has a saved 'Hivemapper' dashboard (dune.com/hivemapperdollarhoney style) and a sibling Weekly Burns query exists (satoshiyourmother, query 6149668).

dashboards.name: Hivemapper Rewards by Type (Syndica)
dashboards.notes: Emissions side, decoded-spell grade. Syndica (well-known Solana infra/data team) groups hivemapper_solana.rewards by month and reward_type (map consumption, AI training, etc.), returning total_amount (HONEY emitted) and recipient counts per month. Uses the curated hivemapper_solana.rewards spell rather than raw mintTo, so it splits emissions by reward category. Companion quarterly 'Reward Recipients' queries (4058991/4059107/4059112/4243846) and 'Median Rewards in USD' (4442610) under the same team.

dashboards.name: hivemapper_daily_overview / weekly_overview (Artemis)
dashboards.notes: Comprehensive per-period series from Artemis (known crypto-data analytics firm). Weekly mints (total emission), mapping rewards, QA rewards, and burns off the HONEY mint via spl_token_solana mintTo/burn plus invoice-program MintTo log parsing. Returns weekly totals, cumulative, and contributor/burner wallet counts. Sister query 3603325 (daily_contributors); maybeYonas authored an earlier weekly_overview (3519214/3646249).

dashboards.name: Hivemapper - Tokens Burn / Tokens Mint (davees)
dashboards.notes: Simplest, most directly reusable daily build inputs. 4419203 = daily tokens_burned (date_trunc('day') over spl_token_call_burn, HONEY mint, since 2022-10-31); companion 4419487 = daily tokens_mint (spl_token_call_mintTo). davees also has 'Hivemapper - Revenue' (4421380) and 'Revenue (Burns)' (4422018). Community-built but clean and easy to fork/parameterize for a custom monthly roll-up.

fallback: No protocol-owned dashboard is usable: the official Hivemapper-team handles exist but their dashboards are empty (dune.com/evan_hivemapper/honey has zero widgets; dune.com/gabe_hivemapper/hivemapper has one). To build the per-period emission/burn series directly, query Solana SPL token call tables on Dune for HONEY mint 4vMsoUT2BWatFweudnQM1xedRLfJgJ7hswhcpz4xgBTy: emissions = SELECT date_trunc('month', call_block_time) AS month, SUM(amount/1e9) AS honey_emitted FROM spl_token_solana.spl_token_call_mintTo WHERE account_mint='4vMsoUT2BWatFweudnQM1xedRLfJgJ7hswhcpz4xgBTy' AND call_block_time > date'2022-10-31' GROUP BY 1 (exclude the pre-2022-11-01 ~6B genesis mint); burns = same shape over spl_token_solana.spl_token_call_burn. For emissions split by reward category use the decoded spell hivemapper_solana.rewards (block_time, reward_type, amount, to_owner). Join prices.usd (contract_address = from_base58(mint)) for USD. Alternatively use the Sim API / Dune Sim SVM endpoints for token transfer/supply history, or Solana RPC getSignaturesForAddress on the mint authority. Pair token amounts with the official HONEY tokenomics (BME model) docs to label emission tranches."

dashboards.name: DIMO Protocol Metrics (official flagship)
dashboards.notes: Official DIMO team dashboard. Dedicated 'Baseline Issuance' section (text widget documents 1,105,000 DIMO/week, decreasing 15% annually over 40 years), plus 'DIMO Protocol Fees & Staking', 'DIMO Removed From Circulation' (net-fee burns + staking lockups, with un-lock deductions), and gross vs net protocol revenue widgets. Built on the decoded Polygon rewards contract; charts are time-series so yield per-week/per-month emitted and removed-from-circulation token amounts. Most comprehensive single official surface.

dashboards.name: DIMO Taken out of Circulation and Protocol Revenue (official)
dashboards.notes: Official DIMO team dashboard dedicated to the burn-equivalent (tokens permanently moved to a protocol wallet / removed from circulating supply) and protocol revenue. Text explicitly frames a monthly series ('every month, thousands of DIMO are permanently taken out'). Best official source specifically for the per-period removed-from-circulation (burn-proxy) and protocol-revenue amounts. Shares visualizations with olreliable's underlying queries.

dashboards.name: dimo_rewards_polygon Baseline Issuance (analyst query)
dashboards.notes: Saved query by olreliable (the analyst whose visualizations power the two official dashboards above). SQL groups dimo_rewards_contract_polygon.Reward_evt_TokensTransferred by week: SUM(_amount/1e18) AS baseline_issuance, plus cumulative and planned-vs-actual decay curve (1105000 * 0.85^(week/52.14)). This is the canonical reference SQL for the per-period emitted series. Caveat: latest_execution_state is FAILED (the planned-issuance CTE row-numbers off a quickswap trades table, which is fragile); the actual-issuance CTE itself is sound and trivially re-runnable.

dashboards.name: DIMO Avg Weekly Rewards (analyst query, runs clean)
dashboards.notes: Saved query, latest_execution_state COMPLETED. Cleanly computes weekly_issuance = DATE_TRUNC('week', evt_block_time), SUM(_amount/1e18) FROM dimo_rewards_contract_polygon.Reward_evt_TokensTransferred, plus weekly distinct recipients and issuance-per-recipient. It surfaces only the latest week, but the weekly_issuance CTE is the exact per-period emission series; drop the latest_week filter to get the full weekly history. Cleanest working reference for the build input.

dashboards.name: DIMO Issuance - Wallets (analyst query, daily grain)
dashboards.notes: Saved query, COMPLETED. Daily-grain aggregation of the same Reward_evt_TokensTransferred event (DATE_TRUNC('day', evt_block_time)), counting distinct recipient wallets per day; joins DIMO/USDC price from uniswap_v3_ethereum.trades. Demonstrates the daily-period pattern on the rewards contract; reward amount column is present in the source table and easily added to get daily emitted DIMO.

fallback: If you need a fresh, fully-controlled per-period series rather than re-running someone's saved query, the decoded Dune table is the build input: createAndExecuteQuery against dimo_rewards_contract_polygon.Reward_evt_TokensTransferred (the DIMO baseline-rewards/issuance contract on Polygon). Per-period EMISSIONS: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month'|'week'|'day', evt_block_time) AS period, SUM(CAST(_amount AS DOUBLE)/1e18) AS dimo_emitted FROM dimo_rewards_contract_polygon.Reward_evt_TokensTransferred GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1. For BURNS / removed-from-circulation: DIMO has no classic burn; the protocol moves net-fee tokens to a dedicated wallet (out-of-circulation). Reproduce the official 'Taken out of Circulation' dashboard by tracking ERC20 transfers of the DIMO token (Polygon token 0xE261D618a959aFfFd53168Cd07D12E37B26761db) into that protocol wallet plus staking-lockup contract balances (net of unlocks), grouped by period; or fork the dimo_network dashboard widgets. Token contract / event ABI confirmable via Blockscout get_contract_abi on chain_id 137, or searchTablesByContractAddress for the decoded namespace. As a non-Dune path, the DIMO rewards contract emits TokensTransferred events readable via any Polygon RPC / Blockscout get_token_transfers_by_address, bucketed by block timestamp into monthly/weekly sums."

dashboards.name: Monthly BONK Burns (query)
dashboards.notes: Saved query, not a dashboard. SQL: tokens_solana.transfers WHERE token_mint='DezXAZ8z7PnrnRJjz3wXBoRgixCa6xjnB7YaB1pPB263' AND action='burn', grouped DATE_TRUNC('month'). Returns burn_month, monthly_burned_tokens, monthly_burned_usd, monthly_burn_transactions, plus cumulative columns. No date cap; latest exec 2025. Cleanest current monthly emitted/burned series. Community analyst.

dashboards.name: BONK BURN (dashboard)
dashboards.notes: Dedicated burn dashboard (4 widgets). Backed by sibling queries incl. 'BONK BURNED BY MONTH' (query 3835009: monthly total_burned via spl_token_solana.spl_token_call_burnChecked) and a daily burn query. Monthly query is hard-capped at block_time < 2025-01-01, so fork and remove the upper date bound to bring current. Community.

dashboards.name: BONK burn (PYOR query)
dashboards.notes: Team-owned by PYOR (recognized token-analytics firm). Daily series: DATE_TRUNC('day') over spl_token_solana.spl_token_call_burnChecked for BONK mint since 2022-01-01, with cumulative_burn window. Yields daily_burned + cumulative. Reliable, semi-authoritative analyst source. Roll up to monthly trivially.

dashboards.name: BONK burning on Solana +table (dashboard)
dashboards.notes: Burn-focused dashboard: one chart widget + one table widget over BONK burns. Per-period burn visuals present. Text widget solicits donations (community/hobby board), so treat as supplementary cross-check rather than primary. Community.

dashboards.name: Bonk SPL Token Stats (dashboard)
dashboards.notes: Long-standing, grant-supported community board by wagg + ennnas (well-known Solana analysts). Broad token stats: supply, transactions, DAU, cumulative wallets, top holders, core/airdrop wallet flows. Comprehensive context but widgets are not a dedicated monthly/daily burn-amount series; use the standalone burn queries for the build input.

fallback: If a maintained dashboard is not preferred, build the per-period burn series directly in DuneSQL (no protocol-official Dune handle exists for BONK; all candidates are community/analyst). Canonical pattern, BONK mint = DezXAZ8z7PnrnRJjz3wXBoRgixCa6xjnB7YaB1pPB263: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', call_block_time) AS month, SUM(amount / POWER(10, decimals)) AS burned FROM spl_token_solana.spl_token_call_burnChecked WHERE account_mint = 'DezXAZ8z7PnrnRJjz3wXBoRgixCa6xjnB7YaB1pPB263' AND call_block_time >= TIMESTAMP '2022-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1. Equivalent via tokens_solana.transfers WHERE token_mint_address = '<mint>' AND action = 'burn' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', block_time) (adds amount_usd). For mechanism-specific burns (BonkBot/LetsBonk fee-buyback-and-burn) add a from_owner/call_tx_signer filter on the fee wallet (e.g. ZG98FUCjb8mJ824Gbs6RsgVmr1FhXb2oNiJHa2dwmPd for BonkBot fees; 6QyD4vG1GNdZWyFBtSUNxvLszm2kxqgH1DtYTE8WZgs1 for the LetsBonk burn wallet). Non-Dune fallback: Solana RPC/Helius parsed Burn/BurnChecked instructions for the mint, or Solscan/Birdeye token-burn endpoints, bucketed by day/month. BONK has no algorithmic emission/inflation (fixed genesis supply), so the meaningful per-period token-flow series is burns, not emissions."

dashboards.name: $W Token
dashboards.notes: Most comprehensive W-token-focused community dashboard (27 viz; tagged Wormhole/W Token). Contains: top-10000 and top-1000 holder concentration, holder-bucket distribution, a '$W Locked Token Balance' bridge-locked snapshot (queryId 3676351), Solana DEX $W volume stats, and ONE time series '$W New/Cumulative Holders' by block_date (queryId 3680929). All token-amount panels are point-in-time snapshots (balances/concentration), not a per-period emitted/unlocked series. No emission, unlock, vesting, inflation, or burn time series. Closest build input is the cumulative-holders trend, which is not token-amount emission.

dashboards.name: Wormhole Staking on EVM
dashboards.notes: Tracks $W held/staked on EVM via token_balances tables. Author flags outlier inaccuracies (CEX deposit addresses captured) and explicitly defers to bennyback's dashboard as more accurate. Stock of staked W, not a per-period rewards/emission flow. No reward-amount-per-period series.

dashboards.name: Wormhole Stake, Delegate and Delegator Dashboard
dashboards.notes: Staking/delegation participation dashboard (cited by other authors as the accurate staking reference). Measures staked/delegated W stock and delegator counts, not staking reward emission per period. Wormhole staking is non-inflationary (no on-chain reward mint), so no emitted-token series here. Advanced variant: dune.com/bennyback/wormhole-stake-delegate-and-delegator-dashboard-advanced.

dashboards.name: Wormhole Airdrop Official Dashboard 2024
dashboards.notes: Despite the 'Official' label, owned by community user mblahhe (not the Wormhole Foundation). It is a parameterized airdrop-eligibility wallet checker (queryId 3270333), not a token-issuance series. The one-time airdrop allocation is not a recurring per-period emission. Does not yield a monthly/daily emitted-token series.

dashboards.name: $W Locked Token Balance (query)
dashboards.notes: Underlying query for the locked-balance panel on the 1king1 dashboard. Returns current total W locked in the Wormhole bridge (target_chain/token_chain breakdown), a single snapshot value. Not a per-period unlock/vesting release series. Listed as the nearest on-chain 'locked' anchor but it measures bridge custody, not tokenomics vesting unlocks.

fallback: No Dune dashboard reconstructs a per-period W emission/unlock/vesting/burn token series. Searched dashboards and queries for variants ['wormhole','$W','W token','wormhole staking','wormhole unlock','wormhole vesting','wormhole emission','wormhole token supply'] via Dune MCP plus a confirming WebSearch (site:dune.com): every hit is bridge volume/TVL, the 2022 bridge hack, holder concentration, staking/delegation stock, or airdrop-eligibility checking. None is owned by an official Wormhole/Wormhole-Foundation handle, and none yields an emitted/unlocked-per-period amount. This is structural: W is a fixed 10B-supply genesis-minted Solana SPL token; 'emission' is off-chain vesting/cliff custody releases (Core Contributors, Strategic Network Participants, Guardian Nodes, Foundation, Community/Ecosystem), not an on-chain inflationary mint, so a clean per-period series is not recoverable from Dune base tables. BUILD PATH: (1) Authoritative unlock schedule from off-chain trackers: Tokenomist/TokenUnlocks (tokenomist.ai/wormhole), CoinGecko W vesting/unlock tab, and the Wormhole tokenomics docs (wormhole.com/token, the 48-month linear-after-1-year-cliff schedule starting ~2024-04). These give the canonical monthly unlock amounts directly. (2) On-chain cross-check: track W SPL mint (Solana, mint address 85VBFQZC9TZkfaptBWjvUw7YbZjy52A6mjtPGjstQAmQ) flows out of the known vesting/treasury custody wallets per month via Solana SPL transfer tables (spl_token_solana.token_transfers or stablecoins-style balance deltas) and Wormhole circulating-supply growth month-over-month as a proxy for net unlocked. (3) If a Dune build is required, author a new query computing monthly net inflow from foundation/vesting custody addresses to circulating wallets (custody-address list from the tokenomics docs/Etherscan-Solscan labels); there is no existing query to fork for this. Off-chain trackers (path 1) are faster and more accurate than any Dune reconstruction for the W unlock series."

dashboards.name: WLFI Unlocks Tracker
dashboards.notes: Purpose-built for WLFI unlocks. Sources the decoded vester Claimed-event table (wlfi_ethereum.worldlibertyfinancialvester_evt_claimed, vester 0x74b4...9583; WLFI token 0xda5e...bef6). Documents a Cumulative & daily unlocks section plus claimed_24h / claimed_7d KPIs and a sell-pressure section (CEX deposits + DEX sells vs unlocks). The per-claim event source trivially yields a daily/monthly unlocked (emission) series via date_trunc. Community-built but the cleanest unlock-specific dashboard found. Unlock start Sept 1 2025; 100B total supply.

dashboards.name: World Liberty Financial (WLFI) - seoul
dashboards.notes: seoul is the most comprehensive WLFI analyst on Dune (owns the main WLFI dashboard, Daily Transfer Volume query, Sales, Holdings). Companion query WLFI - Burn (query 5721856) returns per-tx net burn (mint/burn to/from 0x0) with running total_burn and running supply = 100B + cumsum, date-filtered from 2025-09-01; aggregates directly to a daily/monthly burn-and-supply series. Best community source for burns + circulating-supply deltas.

dashboards.name: WLFI Minted Supply (CCap)
dashboards.notes: CCap team's WLFI Minted Supply query (4600329) selects every mint (from = 0x0) on the WLFI token with evt_block_time and WLFI-minted amount. A raw per-mint emission feed that aggregates straight to monthly/daily minted (gross emission) amounts. The mint side of the same supply equation seoul's burn query covers. Dashboard slug wlfi-dashboard hosts CCap's WLFI query set; confirm individual query is surfaced on it.

dashboards.name: World Liberty Financial (WLFI) Lockbox Claimed Statistics
dashboards.notes: Lockbox / claim-allocation estimator at TGE (24.67B circulating at TGE; 20% presale unlock). Strong on who-unlocked-what and claim-size distribution, but framed as a current-state snapshot estimator rather than a per-period unlocked time series. Useful cross-check for the unlock totals but not the primary build feed.

dashboards.name: WLFI (CoinDesk / Sam Kessler analyst set)
dashboards.notes: Well-known analyst (CoinDesk's Sam Kessler) team queries: WLFI Treasury Composition, Top Holders, Sales, WLFI Revenue. Reputable owner, but the queries are holdings / treasury / revenue snapshots rather than a per-period emission or burn series. Listed for analyst credibility; not the emission/burn build input. Verify exact dashboard slug under sam_kessler.

fallback: No official protocol-owned dashboard exists. To build a per-period unlock/emission/burn series directly: (1) UNLOCKS/EMISSIONS: query the decoded vester Claimed events, SELECT date_trunc('day', evt_block_time) AS d, SUM(amount/1e18) AS wlfi_unlocked FROM wlfi_ethereum.worldlibertyfinancialvester_evt_claimed GROUP BY 1 (vester 0x74b4f6a2e579d730aacb9dd23cfbbaeb95029583; this is the canonical unlock/emission feed). (2) GROSS MINTS: SUM(value/1e18) FROM erc20_ethereum.evt_Transfer WHERE from = 0x0 AND contract_address = 0xda5e1988097297dcdc1f90d4dfe7909e847cbef6 GROUP BY date_trunc. (3) BURNS: same evt_Transfer with to = 0x0 (negative), running supply = 100e9 + cumsum(net). All three aggregate to monthly/daily series in DuneSQL. API fallback: Dune Sim / Etherscan token transfer endpoint for the WLFI token + vester contract filtered to mint (from 0x0) and burn (to 0x0) addresses, bucketed by month. Token contract 0xda5e1988097297dcdc1f90d4dfe7909e847cbef6 on Ethereum; total supply 100B; unlock start 2025-09-01."

dashboards.name: Gnosis Analytics (official ecosystem dashboard)
dashboards.notes: Official GnosisChain team master dashboard (dashboard_id 150134). Contains a Validators Overview section that explicitly describes GNO validator rewards (~10% GNO APR, DappNode incentive program). Inspected validator widgets, however, plot validator COUNTS/status/entities over time (viz 7683256, 6272030, 7009749), not a per-period GNO-rewards-EMITTED token amount. No emission/inflation/burn flow series surfaced. Best official starting point but does not directly hand you the build input.

dashboards.name: GNO (official saved query: daily GNO balance by label)
dashboards.notes: Official GnosisChain query_id 4378268 (depends on query_4378260 gnosis_gno_labels_sparse_daily_balance_v). Produces a DAILY GNO BALANCE panel per label (forward-filled sparse balances), i.e. a STOCK by holder/label, not a FLOW. You could differencing-derive net flow per label, but it is not an emission/burn series and double-counts transfers. Useful for supply-distribution, not per-period emission.

dashboards.name: Gnosis Beacon Chain (Deposits)
dashboards.notes: Official dashboard_id 12939. Tracks GNO/mGNO DEPOSITS into the validator deposit contract over time (staking inflows, validator activations). This is staking participation, not GNO issuance/rewards. Could be repurposed: the same deposit-contract approach (claims/withdrawals) is where a true GNO-rewards-issued series must be built, but this dashboard shows deposits only.

dashboards.name: Gnosis Revenue Accrual
dashboards.notes: Official dashboard_id 156001. Weekly USD revenue accrual to GnosisDAO (lending fees, sDAI/EURe imputed interest, Gnosis Pay 20bps, Circles/CRC). Denominated in USD, not GNO; about value capture not token emission/burn. Not an emission build input.

dashboards.name: Gnosis Chain Metrics (Hashed Emergent)
dashboards.notes: Community analyst (Hashed Emergent team) chain-metrics dashboard (dashboard_id 152334). General Gnosis Chain activity/usage metrics; not verified to contain a per-period GNO emission/burn series. Listed as the best non-official-team alternative if the official dashboards are insufficient.

fallback: No pre-built Dune dashboard yields a per-period GNO emitted/burned token series, because GNO has essentially no protocol-level emission, inflation, or burn: it is a FIXED-SUPPLY token (10M GNO minted at genesis; the GNO->mGNO 1:32 conversion for staking is a wrapper, not new issuance), and there is no GNO burn mechanism. The ONE genuine recurring GNO outflow is consensus-layer VALIDATOR STAKING REWARDS (GNO paid to Gnosis Chain validators, ~10% GNO APR target / DappNode incentive program). To build a per-period GNO-issued (rewards) series: (1) On Gnosis Chain (Blockscout/Dune chain_id 100), index the GBC deposit/claim/withdrawal contract that distributes GNO validator rewards (deposit contract 0x0B98057eA310F4d31F2a452B414647007d1645d9 and the associated SBC/claim-registry contracts); sum reward (GNO/mGNO) claim or mint events bucketed monthly/daily. The official 'Gnosis Beacon Chain (Deposits)' dashboard (query family behind dashboard_id 12939) and the 'GNO' label-balance query (4378260/4378268) are the cleanest reusable substrates to fork. (2) Alternatively, for total-supply confirmation (expect a flat ~10M GNO line, i.e. zero net emission), query erc20_ethereum.evt_Transfer / tokens.transfers for the GNO contract 0x6810e776880C02933D47DB1b9fc05908e5386b96 (Ethereum) and 0x9C58BAcC331c9aa871AFD802DB6379a98e80CEdb (Gnosis Chain), computing mint(from=0x0)-minus-burn(to=0x0) per period; this verifies the no-emission/no-burn conclusion. (3) For staking-reward APR/issuance context, Gnosis docs and the gnosischain_team Gnosis Analytics validators section are the canonical references. Recommend confirming with the requester whether 'emission' for GNO should be interpreted as validator-reward issuance (the only nonzero series) or treated as zero (fixed supply).

dashboards.name: Sky Smart Burn Engine - Buybacks (query)
dashboards.notes: BEST build input for the current Sky-era Smart Burn Engine. Read the SQL: produces a DAILY series (day, sky_bought, usd_spent) plus cumulative columns. Source = dex.trades filtered to taker = MCD Pause Proxy (0xbe8e...98fb) buying SKY (0x5607...9279), plus sky_evt_transfer burns to 0x0/0xdead, from 2024-09-01. Tracks the SKY token (post-MKR-rebrand buybacks/burns), NOT legacy MKR. Community-owned (not the official Sky handle) but freshest (version 9) and most directly on-target. Saved-query URL form; verify it sits on a bperko dashboard if a dashboard URL is needed.

dashboards.name: Sky - MKR Burn (query, Steakhouse Financial)
dashboards.notes: Best per-period series for LEGACY MKR burns. Owned by Steakhouse Financial, MakerDAO/Sky's official financial-reporting team (de-facto official analyst). SQL yields daily ts, dai (DAI spent on buyback), tokens (MKR burned), plus cumulative cummkr/cumdai, back to 2020-01-01. Pulls from dune.steakhouse.result_maker_accounting code 31420 joined to prices.usd MKR. Directly gives the monthly/daily MKR-burned token series. Saved-query URL; lives under Steakhouse dashboards.

dashboards.name: MKR | Supply & Burn (dashboard, ketcher)
dashboards.notes: Ready-built dashboard with MKR supply + burn time-series visuals and Smart Burn Engine / Original Burn Engine / Black Thursday date annotations. Underlying queries (e.g. MKR Burn (Dai) 3627278, MKR Supply 3328985) are per-period and exportable. Community-owned but well-constructed and MKR-focused. Good visual confirmation surface; component queries are the actual build input.

dashboards.name: Sky Smart Burn Engine - % of total supply burned (query, bperko)
dashboards.notes: Companion to query 6816280 but this one is a SNAPSHOT pie (Burned vs Unburned % of SKY total supply), NOT a per-period series. Useful context only; not a build input on its own.

dashboards.name: Sky Farming Deposits by Refcode (query, virady)
dashboards.notes: Daily Sky farming Referral-event deposit amounts by refcode (contract 0x0650...0275). This is farming DEPOSIT inflow, not reward-token emission, so weak fit for the rewards/emissions axis. Closest pre-built surface found for the SubDAO/Sky-farming side, but does not yield emitted reward token amounts per period. No pre-built dashboard found that gives per-period SubDAO farming reward emissions in SKY/USDS.

fallback: For legacy MKR vs current SKY, pick the matching token. Current Sky-era buyback/burn: replicate bperko query 6816280: dex.trades WHERE token_bought_address = SKY (0x56072C95FAA701256059aa122697B133aDEd9279) AND taker = MCD Pause Proxy (0xbe8e3e3618f7474f8cb1d074a26affef007e98fb), DATE_TRUNC('day'/'month', block_time), SUM token_bought_amount_raw/1e18; plus actual burns from sky_ethereum.sky_evt_transfer WHERE to IN (0x0, 0xdead). Legacy MKR burns: maker_ethereum.mkr_evt_burn (DATE_TRUNC + SUM(wad)/1e18) for raw burn token amounts, or Steakhouse query 3748833 (dune.steakhouse.result_maker_accounting code 31420). MKR/SKY net supply (mint - burn): maker_ethereum.mkr_evt_mint minus mkr_evt_burn, plus the MkrToSky upgrade contract 0xBDcFCA946b6CDd965f99a839e4435Bcdc1bc470B MkrToSky event (topic0 0x751bfeaa...8ce1a). On-chain/API alternative: ERC20 Transfer events for MKR (0x9f8F72aA9304c8B593d555F12eF6589cC3A579A2) and SKY to/from the zero/dead addresses via Etherscan/Blockscout or a node, aggregated per period. SubDAO farming reward emissions have no clean pre-built per-period Dune query; build from the Sky farming/rewards distribution contracts' reward-claim or RewardAdded events, or use Sky's official rewards-config + USDS Savings Rate accrual."

dashboards.name: MetaDAO mint and burn History on Solana (saved query)
dashboards.notes: DIRECT build input. Queries tokens_solana.transfers for the canonical META mint METADDFL6wWMWEoKTFJwcThTbUmtarRJZjRpzUvkxhr, filters action IN ('mint','burn'), and SUMs amount/1e9 grouped by DATE_TRUNC('day', block_time) and action. That is exactly a per-day emitted/burned token series. Community-owned (not official). Minor build tweaks: it ORDER BYs total_amount instead of date and has no date-range param, both trivial to adjust. The cached execution had expired at check time but the SQL is valid and re-runnable.

dashboards.name: MetaDAO Statistics (official analytics team)
dashboards.notes: Official MetaDAO analytics team dashboard. Comprehensive and well-maintained (daily FutarchyAMM volume, protocol fees to MetaDAO, Meteora fees, Assets Under Futarchy, treasury). It does NOT track META token emission/burn or supply per period; it is a protocol-revenue/volume/treasury surface. Best official source overall but not the per-period mint/burn series. Has parameterized start_date and token_list filters.

dashboards.name: MetaDAO Metrics (official MetaDAO team)
dashboards.notes: Owned by the official MetaDAO team handle. Focused on taker volume (OpenbookV2, AMM) and aggregate trading statistics; no emission/burn/supply time series. Confirms there is no official emissions dashboard.

dashboards.name: MetaDAO Metrics (community)
dashboards.notes: Community metrics dashboard. Not inspected in depth; name suggests general protocol metrics rather than a token emission/burn series. Lower priority than the mint/burn query for the build.

dashboards.name: MetaDAO-$META (community)
dashboards.notes: Token-focused dashboard whose backing queries (MetaDAO_Fees, MetaDAO_DEX Volume, MetaDAO_Holder Growth, MetaDAO_Top Holders, MetaDAO_Transaction Count) cover fees, DEX volume, holder growth and concentration. No emission/burn or per-period supply series. Holder-growth could be a secondary supply-context source but is not the build input.

fallback: If query 4121914 is unavailable, rebuild trivially with DuneSQL: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', block_time) AS dt, action, SUM(TRY_CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(38,0)))/1e9 AS amount FROM tokens_solana.transfers WHERE token_mint_address = 'METADDFL6wWMWEoKTFJwcThTbUmtarRJZjRpzUvkxhr' AND action IN ('mint','burn') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1 (add DATE_TRUNC('month',...) for monthly). META is an SPL token on Solana (mint METADDFL6wWMWEoKTFJwcThTbUmtarRJZjRpzUvkxhr, 9 decimals). Non-Dune alternative: Solana RPC/Helius getSignaturesForAddress + parsed MintTo/Burn instructions on the mint, or Solscan/SolanaFM token-supply-change endpoints. MetaDAO emissions are small (futarchy-launched token), so a single daily transfers query covers the full history cheaply."
